name: @even/hello-hud
description: First Even Hub app: a heads-up display driven by the @even/core plugin model.

scripts.qr: evenhub qr --ip "$(ipconfig getifaddr "$(route -n get default | awk '/interface:/{print $2}')")" --port 5173 --http
scripts.pack: npm run build && evenhub pack app.json ./dist --output ../../hello-hud.ehpk
